_doc: File-scoped exceptions to the no-leak blacklist. Each entry needs a justification. A bank name, a date, a code or a brief sentence never belongs here.

testgen.py.deceased: the generic case generator's family name 'Deceased' (a key of testbed/generator/assemble.py's plan tables): testgen must name the generator's families to plan and drop them; it is the generator's code API, not a brief value
testgen.py.declined: the generic case generator's family name 'Declined questions' (same reason as above)

rulecov.py.deceased: rule-type vocabulary of the coverage analyser (rulecov.py): it names the side-intent kinds it looks for in any brief; it builds nothing from them
